address: 52 Nguyen Cong Tru Street, Ward 19, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, 72323, Vietnam
bio: Despite expanding, Phở Chào has lost none of street-side charm. Choose between a rich three-day beef-bone stock and chicken broth. Top dishes include phở bắp hoa with medium-rare beef, crispy fried chicken gà tôm mắm sốt, and phở tine – a fusion of beef noodle soup, French fries and cheese....
